description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams within the namespace OrangeHRM\Time\Dto. The class is a data transfer object (DTO) that extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams to encapsulate filter parameters for employee report searches, including employee number, project ID, activity ID, and timesheet inclusion options.

classes.name: EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for filtering employee reports with properties related to employee number, project, activity, and timesheet options. Includes validation and default settings.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID associated with the filter.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID for the filter.

methods.name: getActivityId
methods.description: Returns the activity ID associated with the filter.

methods.name: setActivityId
methods.description: Sets the activity ID for the filter.

methods.name: getIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Returns the timesheet inclusion filter option.

methods.name: setIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Sets the timesheet inclusion filter option, validating against allowed values.
